name: The Hearts of Naturalities
source:
After the defeat of the demon lord, the world finds itself in an era of peace. Instead of focusing on war efforts and advancing weaponry and magic, kingdoms now focus on creating a better future for their subjects. One of these projects is the unification of the races that inhabit the lands.

That is how Janus Magic Academy came to be. You’ll find all sorts of students here ranging from the elegant but mysterious high elves to the thuggish and loud demons.

By some act of grace, you were admitted to attend JMA. Dawning your first-year uniform, you hope for a peaceful school life, but it seems whoever blessed you to come to JMA also decided to make your life a living hell.

[from [url=https://orx-hara.itch.io/the-hearts-of-naturalities]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
打败魔王后，世界进入和平时代。王国现在不再专注于战争努力和先进武器和魔法，而是专注于为其臣民创造更美好的未来。这些项目之一是统一居住在这片土地上的种族。

这就是杰纳斯魔法学院的由来。你会在这里找到各种各样的学生，从优雅而神秘的高等精灵到凶残而喧闹的恶魔。

出于某种恩典，你被JMA录取了。当你穿上一年级校服时，你希望过上平静的学校生活，但似乎无论谁祝福你来到JMA，也决定让你的生活变成人间地狱。

[来自[url=https://orx-hara.itch.io/the-hearts-of-naturalities]Itch.io[/url]]
